subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should editable Control UI composer dictation be accepted as a core Control UI/Gateway feature via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027, folded into broader web voice work, or rejected/narrowed?
rationale: This adds new user-facing browser microphone UX plus Gateway/provider audio handling, so current code can show the gap but cannot decide whether the new core surface belongs in OpenClaw without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Review linked PR as candidate
options.body: Treat the open linked PR as the implementation candidate and require PR-level security, provider-routing, cleanup, UI, docs, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader voice direction
options.body: Keep this issue open but make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 the broader canonical product discussion if maintainers want one web voice roadmap first.

options.title: Reject core dictation surface
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR if maintainers decide editable composer dictation should not ship in core Control UI now.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as candidate
recommendation.body: Treat the open linked PR as the implementation candidate and require PR-level security, provider-routing, cleanup, UI, docs, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the earlier merged server-side dictation path and is the strongest feature-history owner for deciding whether this returns as core Control UI/Gateway behavior.
